d:
Phir bhi kabhi chala jaoonga usi darvaze tak anayas jaise,
Us andhiyare galiyare men koee ab tak rahta ho.
Phir bhi, divar ki kil par atka dunga naya kailendar,
Kisi ko yon hi patr likh dunga—main bimar hun
Sine par adhkhuli kitab rakhkar so jaoonga;
Chay barf ho rahi hai kahkar, koee mujhe jagae nahin
Nanha-sa koee bachcha mere bistar par aae nahin,
Main bahut bimar ho gaya hun!
